_comment: getLyricsBySongId with only an unsynced entry. Note the lines carry NO `start` key
at all — Navidrome omits it for unsynced lyrics. Requiring `start` here would make
every unsynced response fail to parse and fall through to the legacy endpoint,
silently losing lyrics the server actually had. The lines join with newlines.
The second entry has NO `synced` key: `!undefined` is true in the TypeScript, so it
counts as unsynced too — but the first non-empty unsynced entry still wins.
